limitations: Entire-text and centered600 token spans use fixed full-fit vocabulary/IDF. Windows are not matched discourse. Within-source cells exclude self-pairs.

topic_diagnostics.selection_rule: Display four components where available, declared for readability; no optimal topic count or validated labels claimed.

clusters.selection_rule: Maximum seed-11 cosine silhouette among k=2..8; no corpus/entity labels used for fitting or selection.
clusters.scope: SVD positions visualize lexical vectors. Stable partitions can reflect editorial form, hosts, source kind, dates or vocabulary.

network.rule: Top 25 cross-context TF-IDF pairs, not independent corroboration or attributed-entity agreement. No threshold selected for inference.

sensitivity.rule: Omit official promotion/greeting strata and baseline skeptical-commentary/promotional-interview formats, fixed vocabulary/IDF. All remaining source-format confounds persist.

qa.rule: Question-only common TF-IDF (1,2)-grams,6–80 masked tokens and≥4distinct non-stop unigrams; min_df1; best Ra prompt, cosine≥0.35, margin≥0.03, and≥3shared content unigrams to yield a review lead. Heuristic thresholds have no precision estimate; not an answer recommendation.

qa_leads.question_paraphrase: An interviewer asks whether the present era differs from a thousand years earlier. The displayed cue is a fragment of that question.
qa_leads.response_paraphrase: The Ra passage asks for the name of a visitor sent in antiquity; the printed answer names Yahweh.
limitations: Query speaker and answer unknown; Ra pairing is documentary attribution.
High lexical score can reflect generic wording; source reading required.
qa_leads.comparison: Shared time-span wording conceals different questions. The interview cue has no identified answer; the Ra answer is documentary attribution only.

limitations: Source-context comparison, not attribution of every utterance to a medium, channellee or civilization. Most machine-text speaker roles are unknown.
Selected accessible sources have different dates, genres, publication lengths, recognition errors and editorial histories; no random sample of channeling or of uploads.
Exact media or text aliases were collapsed in accepted studies. Repost, excerpt and historical-session dependence beyond those exact hashes is unresolved.
TF-IDF cosine measures shared vocabulary. NMF weights are descriptive factors, not topic probabilities; clusters are not validated entity classes.
Punctuation candidates and adjacent text are not identified questions and answers. Only Ra has documentary printed prompt-response pairing; no voice or claimed-entity identity verified.
No p-values, causal influence, origin probabilities, sentiment of an entity, trained weights or new neural inference are asserted. Prior neural studies retain their own input preprocessing.

Future ingestion uses no non-Bashar minimum duration and a 300-second Bashar minimum. This frozen accepted-text snapshot does not retroactively repair historical sampling or represent all uploaded videos.
